case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Mountain Morning Opening Title
tests: Checks exact, legible title-card text, its opening placement and duration, and the transition into moving scenery.

faults.what: The title says “A quitter kind of morning” instead of the required “A quieter kind of morning.”
The title card is still visible at 2.3 seconds, so the cut to the lake occurs later than requested.

judge.summary: The clip has an attractive misty sunrise lake scene, but the title is misspelled and remains onscreen too long.

must_haves.item: The opening title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', with no quotation marks or extra text.
must_haves.why: The visible title reads “A quitter kind of morning”; there are no quotation marks or extra text.

must_haves.item: The title is legible cream lettering on a dark green card, fully inside the frame.
must_haves.why: The cream serif lettering is clear, centered, and comfortably within the dark green frame.

must_haves.item: The title card occupies approximately the first 2 seconds, then cuts to the lake scene.
must_haves.why: The title remains visible at 2.3 seconds; the lake first appears in the supplied samples at 3.8 seconds.

must_haves.item: The remaining scene shows a misty mountain lake at sunrise with visible slow camera or scene motion.
must_haves.why: The later frames show a mountain lake with low mist and warm sunrise light, with subtle changes in mist and framing between samples.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 6 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are 16:9 and the supplied clip information states 6 seconds, but silence cannot be verified from still images.
